name: Eskil
title: Keeper of the Third Stone
examine: Eighteen years on the Old Road and eleven walks of it. A pit lamp on a driven stake out front, never a post, and a slate in chalk because the number changes down.
lines: Kingsdelf, forty-one stones, nine lit. The slate is chalk because the number changes. It changes down more than up. I keep writing it.
A road that is not there cannot be lit. There are holes under the eleventh stone. Fill them. I do not care with what.
I have carried more new feet back up this road than the order has, and I will say that once, and now I have said it.
